# Paper draft (DRAFT - not for distribution; authorship and framing pending advisor review)

* `main.tex`: LaTeX source (article, 11pt). Not compiled here: no TeX engine was available in the
  build environment; compile with `pdflatex main.tex` (twice).
* `numbers.tex`: every empirical number, generated by `scripts/paper_numbers.py` from committed
  results (with an anchor check of the confirmatory table against `results/final_test/verdict.json`).
* `figures/`: F1-F5, generated by `scripts/paper_figures.py` from committed results.
* Regenerate: `python scripts/paper_numbers.py && python scripts/paper_figures.py` (matplotlib needed for figures).
